sentences.en: At the end, there were only about five competitors left.
sentences.zh: 1. 到最后只剩下大约五个竞争者了。

sentences.en: This study was funded by one of our competitors.
sentences.zh: 2. 这项研究是由我们的一个竞争对手资助的。

sentences.en: Only one competitor can emerge from the crucible of losers' bracket.
sentences.zh: 3. 只有一个竞争者能从失败者的行列中脱颖而出。
